verdicts.reason: Both make the same mistakes. The headline quote is shrunk to one small line that runs nearly edge to edge, so it no longer leads the layout and the bottle dominates. The quote mark floats far above its text, and the pink circle has come loose from the bottle and sits stranded, cut off in the bottom-right corner. A spreads the stack more evenly down the canvas, with some empty space at the top. B pushes everything up, which leaves a large dead gap between the CTA and the logo, so A is slightly better.
